Report the final density of the system in g/cm³.

{"path":"/results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/brief/tasks/magnesium_melting_trial_2/in.melting","content":"# LAMMPS Input Script for Melting of Magnesium

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

read_data magnesium_data.lmp

pair_style eam
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Mg.eam.alloy Mg

neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 10

thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp pe etotal press vol

# NVT Equilibration
fix 1 all nvt temp 300 300 0.1
run 10000
unfix 1

# NPT Relaxation
fix 1 all npt temp 300 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
run 10000
unfix 1

# NPT Heating
fix 1 all npt temp 300 2000 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
run 20000
unfix 1

write_restart magnesium_melted.restart
"}
